page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then one block of italic text, a catchword-like heading "HISTO-" centred below, and a woodcut ornament below that. No margin notes.

p.i: iucunda, nec exemplo erant necessaria, breue veluti florum corpusculum feci: vt haberent & qui Graca didicissent, quo admonerentur; & qui non didicissent, quo instruerentur. Quod ad te, non tam cognoscendi, magis quàm emendandi causa transmisi: simul vt & otij mei, cuius & Cato reddendam operam putat, apud te ratio constaret. Sufficit enim mihi in tempore iudicium tuum; apud posteros, cum obtrectationis inuidia decesserit, industria testimonium habituro.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a grotesque mask within scrollwork) is not transcribed. The word "HISTO-" is a centred heading at mid-page, a hyphenated line-start of a larger word, so it is kept as printed. Long s rendered as s throughout.
